semantics: Public English 380/A: m,n,x,l in1..10^5,c in1..10^4; copy the first l existing elements c times, l<=current length. Queries are strictly increasing one-based positions within the final sequence. One operation per line and all queries on one line. Unique integer output tokens. Cache only the first10^5 elements and binary-search exact cumulative lengths; copied positions map into that cache. Literal expansion independently checks small programs.
